answer: An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 9 epochs. Because the quill register is reconciled against the cipher funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the shale audit publishes the forfeited amount. Disclosure is low-cost for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which forfeits 9 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
